creator: Alexander Terp
description: Seen 2026-10-24: messaging::a_pane_named_what_a_live_agent_joined_by_is_reached_by_its_callsign in the daemon suite failed once out of four runs of messaging:: on a heavily loaded machine, and passed alone and in the other three. The panic was not captured. The change being tested did not touch callsigns. A flake is a bug here: rerun it under load (several copies at once, or beside a build) and capture what it asserted.
title: A daemon messaging test failed once in four under load: a pane named what a live agent joined by is reached by its callsign
